verdict.rationale: No first-party evidence shows a user-facing export of 2FA seeds or account data in any open format. The documented backup is encrypted multi-device sync that keeps data inside Authy, and the Authy-to-Verify migration doc is a developer API migration, not a user data export. Community reports independently say there is no export option and that leaving required hacky workarounds, such as running the deprecated Chrome extension or debug-mode Electron scripts to dump tokens.
